clk_mngr_api.h

Initialize the clock manager, query clock frequencies, and read or program supported clock divisors.

Constants
CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_MPU

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the MPU core clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_SDMMC

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the SD/MMC clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_SP_TIMER

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the peripheral timer clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_OSC1TIMER

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the OSC1 timer clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_SSPI

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the SPI clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_L4MAIN

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the L4 Main clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_UART

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the UART clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_WDT

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the watchdog timer clock.

CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_I2C

Clock-block identifier passed to clk_mngr_api_get_freq() for the I2C clock.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_L4_SYS_FREE

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for L4_SYS_FREE_CLK.

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for L4_MP_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_L4_SP

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for L4_SP_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_SOFT_PHY

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for SOFT_PHY_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_CCU

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for CCU_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_MPU_PERIPH

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for MPU_PERIPH_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_CS

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for CS_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_CS_TRACE

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for CS_TRACE_CLK.

CLK_MNGR_DIV_CS_PDBG

Divisor selector used by clk_mngr_api_set_divisor() and clk_mngr_api_get_divisor() for CS_PDBG_CLK.

clk_mngr_api_init
int clk_mngr_api_init(
void
)

Initializes the platform Clock Manager settings used by this bare-metal build.  Call this during platform bring-up before querying clock frequencies or changing NOCDIV divisors.

Returns

0 on success; otherwise returns the status from clk_mngr_platform_init().  Current platform implementations can return -ETIMEDOUT while waiting for clock-manager state changes.

clk_mngr_api_get_freq
int clk_mngr_api_get_freq(
uint32_t 
clock_block_id,
uint32_t 
*
freq_hz
)

Returns the current frequency of one supported clock block.

Parameters
clock_block_id
uint32_t

One of the CLK_MNGR_BLOCK_* identifiers.

freq_hz
uint32_t*

Output location for the frequency in hertz.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if freq_hz is NULL or clock_block_id is not supported; otherwise returns the status from clk_mngr_ll_get_clk().

clk_mngr_api_set_divisor
int clk_mngr_api_set_divisor(
uint32_t 
clock_type,
uint8_t 
divisor
)

Programs one NOCDIV control-clock divisor.

Parameters
clock_type
uint32_t

One of the CLK_MNGR_DIV_* identifiers.

divisor
uint8_t

Divisor to program. Supported values are 1, 2, or 4; the CS divider types also support 8.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when the clock type or divisor is not supported.

clk_mngr_api_get_divisor
int clk_mngr_api_get_divisor(
uint32_t 
clock_type,
uint8_t 
*
divisor
)

Reads the currently programmed NOCDIV divisor for one control clock.

Parameters
clock_type
uint32_t

One of the CLK_MNGR_DIV_* identifiers.

divisor
uint8_t*

Output location for the current divisor.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL for a NULL output pointer or an unsupported clock type.

clk_mngr_platform_init
int clk_mngr_platform_init(
void
)

Platform integration hook used by clk_mngr_api_init(). Applications normally call clk_mngr_api_init() rather than this function directly.

Returns

0 on success; -ETIMEDOUT where the selected platform implementation times out while waiting for a clock-manager state transition; otherwise returns that platform implementation's status.
